Subject: Your consumer complaint matter - C.C. No. 1581/2021

Dear Ms. Sathe,

Thank you for meeting us on 20 March 2022 about your dispute with M/s Sunrise Realty. As we understand it, the builder never obtained the occupancy certificate.

Our advice is to seek a full refund with interest because the builder failed to obtain the occupancy certificate. Please collect the builder-buyer agreement, payment receipts and the municipal reply on the occupancy certificate and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 61,50,000.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
